sections.text:
1 Computatio astrologica Vetti Valentis ex libris adhuc ineditis excerpta ab
astrologo quodam saec. XII, ut videtur (cf. notulam ad calcem). — De binis litteris
unicuique zodiaci signo attributis vide nunc Boll, Sphaera, p. 469 ss. [F. C.]
sections.en: 1 Astrological computation of Vettius Valens excerpted from books hitherto unedited by a certain astrologer of the 12th century, as it seems (cf. the note at the bottom). — Concerning the two letters attributed to each sign of the zodiac see now Boll, Sphaera, p. 469 ff. [F. C.]

summary.headline: Valens’s Zodiacal Oracle
summary.text: Calendar of star rulers for July through December, assigning named stars to dates and durations of danger or disturbance. It then begins an oracle attributed to Vettius Valens, describing two letters for each zodiac sign and interpreting hexagons, squares, triangles, and diameters.
